behavior.unknown: lost response preserves the exact endpoint/body/idempotency key across denied/conflict retry and successful GET
behavior.rejected: 403/409 without a preceding unknown result is distinct and may be released only after explicit successful refresh
behavior.success: only a successful response matching expected_request_version confirms the current POST
behavior.scope: Context, Workspace, or dashboard transport identity creates a new panel lifetime; old reads and commands cannot cross it

automation.input: Quote draft POST outcome, refresh result, and account/Context/Workspace identity
automation.automatable_part: correlate an in-memory pending command with its exact wire request and fence stale reads by operation generation
automation.human_decision_role: SERVICE owner determines whether a future canonical receipt/lookup can resolve UNKNOWN
automation.execution_conditions: same component lifetime, exact command bytes/key, current scope, and validated response correlation
automation.exception_owner: Core/Finance only if the public receipt or canonical lookup contract changes
automation.formal_dependency: existing quote POST/read schemas and dashboard transport identity
automation.value_criterion: no unknown command is forgotten, re-keyed, duplicated, or replayed under another identity
